execution_policy.count: Six independent source mutants, not six altered observations. Counts remain zero until actual execution. No grouped runtime metamutant, environment lookup or mutable global in L1.
execution_policy.copy: One disposable exact frozen-candidate copy; no live candidate/protected test/L0/oracle edits. Record concrete patch with function anchor and before/after hashes; apply and restore explicitly with apply_patch. Verify exact restoration before next mutant.
execution_policy.compilation: Prefer one shared disposable dev/test target with debug=0, incremental=true, lto=false. Compile the unchanged candidate control first with exactly the same environment/profile; then one narrow mutant and one package compilation at a time. Public-only Source witness requires a compiled typst-wiring CLI, not a test-only mock.
execution_policy.scheduling: Explicit exclusive coordinator build window; never compile in parallel with root. Immutable baseline binaries are not build targets. RAM operations use the authorized host execution mechanism.
execution_policy.cost_boundary: Use the six focal witness/control groups before any final broad replay. Maximum two unsuccessful instrumentation attempts for the same cause, then stop for review. No repeated full matrix just to calibrate a patch anchor.
execution_policy.classification: Nonapplying/noncompiling/timeouts/unresolved source/zero matched tests/malformed observation are Unknown, never killed. A compiled failure remains pending causal review until exact intended public deviation is linked and its unmutated control was GREEN.
execution_policy.preservation: Full argv/cwd/environment/time/stdout/stderr/exit, source and binary hashes, fixture identity, patch and restoration receipts. No indiscriminate path, range, whitespace or diagnostic normalization.
execution_policy.final_scope: Any final score pertains only to these explicitly applicable P1308 mutants. Do not count counterfactual envelope calibration as Rust execution.
